paite: Himahleh tunung chiang in mi khenkhatte'n; pimangna khate leh dawite thuhilhna limsak in, ginna atawpsan ding uh chih Kha in kichiantak in agen hi; huai tuh,
heading: Sinsakmi Takloute

paite: mizuautheite lepchiahna ziak in ahi; huai mizuautheite amau sia-le-pha theihna ngei a sik am a halkeu bang ahi uhi.
Kiten akham ua, nek ding ante, thutak thei a gingtate'n kipahthu gen a san ding a Pathian in asiamte, nek louh ding achi uhi.
Pathian thilsiam chiteng ahoih ngal a, kipahthu gen a san ahih khit nak photleh bangmah deih louh ding ahi kei hi;
Pathian thu leh thumna a hihsiangthou ahi khinta hi.
Huaite unaute na sinsakleh Khrist Jesu nasempa hoihtak, ginna leh thuhilhna hoih tutan a na zuih thu a vaklian na hi ding hi.
heading: Khrist Jesu Nasempa Hoih

paite: Himahleh Pathian zahlouhna leh tangthu bulbal neiloute deih ke'n. Pathian limsak ding in kithuzoh in;
pumpi kisawizoina aphatuam zek a; Pathian limsakna pen tangtawn in, tua omsa hinna leh hong om nawn ding piak chiamna aneih ziak in thil tengteng ah aphatuam hi.
Hiai thu amuanhuai in alak tuak mahmah hi.
Huchi in Pathian hing i muan ziak in i semgim ua, i pang teitei uhi; amah mi tengteng Hondampa ahi a, agingtate Hondampa ahi tuanse hi.
Hiaite thupiak in pia inla, sinsak in.
heading: Timothi Hinkhua Leh Asinsakna

paite: Na naupanna kuamah musitsak ke'n; thugen ah, tatdan ah, itna ah, kha ah, ginna leh sianthouna ah, gingtute zuih ding hi zaw in.
Ka hong pai masiah laisim, hanthawn leh thugin limsak in.
Nangmah a om thilpiak thugenkholhna a piak, upate khut ngak a Pathian in nang ahon neihsak limsak lou ke'n.
Mi tengteng kiang a na phattuamna alattheihna ding in huai thilte ah thanuam inla, kizang zou in.
Nangmah leh na thuhilh ah pilvang in; huai thilte hih in om gige in; huchibang hih in nangmah leh na thuzate na hondam ding hi.
